summary: The midpoint measure is supported on integral fibers by parity and convexity, and its halfspace domination follows from orienting each midpoint edge toward one incident endpoint in the halfspace and charging the resulting loads against the endpoint capacities, with repeated endpoints and coincident midpoint atoms causing no overcounting. The accepted dominated-measure theorem applies with exactly the support-based intrinsic base and residual ranks, including rank-zero cases. The finite capacitated matching primal is compact, its vertex-cover dual is feasible, both optima are attained with equality, and thresholding a dual optimizer at one half gives the claimed factor-two cover while cover indicators give the converse bound. The E_74 specialization uses valid same-parity pairs but correctly makes no comparison between its geometric-mean sum and the capacitated optimum, so it does not claim the unavailable aggregation or final result.
